  PROBLEM: Generator failure paths do not emit the clean operator-readable failure markers expected in CI.
  WHY: qwen rated the missing `::error::` annotations as NIT, while x-ai_grok rated the same failure-path behavior MAJOR because missing JSON, bad schema, unknown override slugs, write failures, and diff mismatches can still bubble up as tracebacks/SystemExit text.
- scripts/generate_codex_model_reference.py:157-194 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The sanitize/render/write path lacks sufficient guards, including handling for empty cells, missing override dicts, and atomic writes/locking.
  WHY: x-ai_grok reported malformed cells or AttributeError risks in the render helpers and concurrent write races on the generated doc path.
